name: TEMA
description: This keyword returns the Triple Exponential Moving Average value of the instrument. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Triple Exponential Moving Average value of the instrument. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632144661.png)

The above condition is checking if the Previous 5 minute (-1) TEMA value is greater than previous to previous 5 minute (-2) TEMA value of Gold futures

The triple exponential moving average (TEMA) is a modified moving average designed to smooth large price fluctuations.

Read more about TEMA here -  https://www.investopedia.com/ask/answers/041315/why-triple-exponential-moving-average-tema-important-traders-and-analysts.asp
